source: The Bells of St. Martin's Fall Silent as Churches in Harlem Struggle
reference: 哈莱姆的教堂疲于生存，圣马丁教堂的钟声陷于沉寂

source: "Historically, the old people I've talked to say there was a bar and a church on every corner," Mr. Adams said.
reference: “过去，跟我说过话的老人都说在每个角落都有一家酒吧和一座教堂，” 亚当斯先生如是说。

source: "Today, there's neither."
reference: “而如今，这两样什么都没有了。”

source: He said the disappearance of bars was understandable.
reference: 他曾表示，酒吧的消失情有可原。

source: "People socialize in a different way" nowadays, he said.
reference: “人们以不同的方式进行社交”，如今他说道。

source: "Bars are no longer neighborhood living rooms where people go on a regular basis."
reference: “酒吧不再是三街四坊的人们经常光顾的会客室。“

source: As for churches, he worries that the money from selling assets will not last as long as leaders expect it to, "and sooner or later they'll be right back where they started."
reference: 至于教堂，他担心变卖资产所得的资金不会维持到领导人所预期的那样长久，“迟早他们从哪儿来就会回到哪里去。”

source: Churches, he added, could be replaced by apartment buildings with condominiums filled with the kind of people who will not help the neighborhood's remaining sanctuaries.
reference: 他还表示，教堂可能会被公寓大楼所代替，公寓里的住户将不会为邻里其他的庇护所提供帮助。

source: "The overwhelming majority of people who buy condominiums in these buildings will be white," he said, "and therefore will hasten the day that these churches close altogether because it is unlikely that most of these people who move into these condominiums will become members of these churches."
reference: “这些大楼内公寓的绝大多数买家将会是白人，”他说，"由于搬进这些公寓的人中的大多数不太可能成为这些教堂的会众，因此会加速这些教堂比邻而居的进程。"

source: Both churches were built by white congregations before Harlem became a black metropolis - Metropolitan Community in 1870, St. Martin's a decade later.
reference: 这两座教堂都是由白人会众在哈莱姆于 1870 年成为黑人大都会-“大都会社区”之前修建的，十年后，圣马丁教堂建成。

source: The original white Methodist congregation moved out in the 1930s.
reference: 原先的白人循道宗会众在 20 世纪 30 年代由此撤出。

source: A black congregation that had been worshiping nearby took title to the building.
reference: 而一直在附近做礼拜的黑人会众则鸠占鹊巢。

source: St. Martin's was taken over by a black congregation under the Rev. John Howard Johnson, who led a boycott of retailers on 125th Street, a main street for shopping in Harlem, who resisted hiring or promoting blacks.
reference: 圣马丁教堂在约翰·霍华德·约翰逊（ John Howard Johnson）牧师领导下为黑人会众所接管。他领导了抵制位于第 125 大街（哈莱姆的主要购物大街），拒绝聘用或提拔黑人的零售店的运动。

source: A fire in 1939 left the building badly damaged, but as Father Johnson's parishioners made plans to rebuild, they commissioned the carillon.
reference: 1939 年发生的一场大火使该建筑严重受损，但由于  Johnson 神父的信徒计划对其进行重建，因此他们委托制造了编钟。

source: The Rev. David Johnson, Father Johnson's son and successor at St. Martin's, proudly called the carillon "the poor people's bells."
reference: 大卫·约翰逊（David Johnson） 牧师是约翰逊神父的儿子以及圣马丁教堂的继任者，他自豪地将该大钟称之为“穷人的大钟“

source: The expert who played the carillon in July called it something else: "A cultural treasure" and "an irreplaceable historical instrument."
reference: 七月份，演奏该编钟的专家将其称为:“文化宝藏”和“无可替代的古乐器"

source: The expert, Tiffany Ng of the University of Michigan, also noted that it was the first carillon in the world to be played by a black musician, Dionisio A. Lind, who moved to the larger carillon at the Riverside Church 18 years ago.
reference: Tiffany Ng 是密西根大学的专家，她还指出这是世界上首套将由一位黑人音乐家，即 Dionisio A. Lind 演奏的编钟，18 年前，他曾演奏过 Riverside 教堂中更大的编钟。

source: Mr. Merriweather said that St. Martin's did not replace him.
reference: Merriweather 先生表示，圣马丁教堂没有更换掉他。

source: What has played out at St. Martin's over the last few months has been a complicated tale of architects and contractors, some brought in by the lay leaders of the church, others by the Episcopal diocese.
reference: 在过去几个月，建筑师与承包商在圣马丁教堂上演了一出情节复杂的故事，有些内容是该教堂的会友领袖提供的，其他的则是由圣公会教区提供的。

source: The vestry - the parish's governing body, made up of lay leaders - wrote the diocese in July with concerns that the diocese "would seek to pass along the costs" to the vestry, even though the vestry had not been involved in hiring the architects and contractors the diocese sent in.
reference: 教区委员会是教区的主管机构，由会友领袖构成，它在七月份写给主教教区的信中不无担忧的表示，主教教区”会寻求将费用转嫁给“教区委员会，尽管后者并未参与聘用主教教区提名的建筑师和承包商的事宜。

source: Some parishioners complained of a lack of transparency on the diocese's part.
reference: 有些信徒埋怨主教教区方面缺乏透明度。

source: Sainsbury's plans push into UK beauty market
reference: Sainsbury's 计划进军英国的美容市场

source: Sainsbury's is taking on Boots, Superdrug and Debenhams with department store-style beauty aisles staffed with specialist assistants.
reference: Sainsbury's 将依托 Boots、Superdrug 和 Debenhams，采取百货商店的风格，设置美容品通道，并派销售专员负责销售。

source: As part of a substantial push into the UK's £2.8bn beauty market, which is continuing to grow while fashion and homeware sales fall back, the larger beauty aisles will be tested out in 11 stores around the country and taken to more stores next year if it proves a success.
reference: 英国美容市场达到 28亿 英镑的规模，尽管时尚和家居行业销售额回落，但该市场还在继续增长，因此 Sainsbury's 将大规模进军该市场，并将在全国 11 家商店试行更大规模的美容品通道，如果试水成功，则明年还将进驻更多商店。

source: The investment in beauty comes as supermarkets hunt for ways to use up shelf space once sued for TVs, microwaves and homeware.
reference: 此次投资美容品市场之际，正值超市想方设法填补原先用于摆放电视、微波炉和家居用品的货架空间。

source: Sainsbury's said it would be doubling the size of its beauty offering to up to 3,000 products, including brands such as Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman and Dr. PawPaw for the first time.
reference: Sainsbury's 表示会将其美容产品规模翻番，达到3000个品种，其中包括首次进驻的 Revlon、Essie、Tweezerman 和 Dr. PawPaw 等品牌。

source: Existing ranges from L'Oreal, Maybelline and Burt's Bees will also get more space with branded areas similar to those found in shops like Boots.
reference: 类似于 Boots 等商店，品牌专区还将提供更多空间给现有的从“欧莱雅”、“美宝莲”到“小蜜蜂”的产品系列。

source: The supermarket is also relaunching its Boutique makeup range so that the majority of products are vegan-friendly - something increasingly demanded by younger shoppers.
reference: 超市也正在重新推出其“精品”化妆品系列，使大多数的产品都彻底含有植物性成分 - 年轻的顾客对其需求日益上升。

source: In addition, perfume retailer the Fragrance Shop will be testing out concessions in two Sainsbury's stores, the first of which opened in Croydon, south London, last week while a second opens in Selly Oak, Birmingham, later this year.
reference: 此外，香水零售商 Fragrance Shop 将在 Sainsbury's的两家门店试水特许经营，第一家已于上周在南伦敦的 Croydon 开业，第二家将于今年晚些时候在伯明翰的 Selly Oak 开业。

source: Online shopping and a shift towards buying small amounts of food daily at local convenience stores means supermarkets are having to do more to persuade people to visit.
reference: 网上购物以及平日在本地便利店购买少量食品的这种购买趋势，意味着超市还要更加努力才能让顾客盈门。

source: Mike Coupe, the chief executive of Sainsbury's, has said the outlets will look increasingly like department stores as the supermarket chain tries to fight back against the discounters Aldi and Lidl with more services and non-food.
reference: Sainsbury's 的首席执行官Mike Coupe 说过 ，折扣店会越来越像百货商店，因为超市连锁店会竭力提供更多服务以及非食物产品来抗衡Aldi 和 Lidl 折扣店。

source: Sainsbury's has been putting Argos outlets in hundreds of stores and has also introduced a number of Habitats since it bought both chains two years ago, which it says has bolstered grocery sales and made the acquisitions more profitable.
reference: Sainsbury's 一直在几百家店部署 Argos 折扣店，而且自从两年前收购了 Habitat 的两家连锁店以来，已经引入了众多的 Habitat， 它表示这一举措带动食品杂货收入增长，使收购带来的盈利更为丰厚。

source: The supermarket's previous attempt to revamp its beauty and pharmacy departments ended in failure.
reference: 该超市以前也曾试图改组其美容品和药品部，但都以失败收场。

source: Sainsbury's tested a joint venture with Boots in the early 2000s, but the tie-up ended after a row over how to split the revenues from the chemist's stores in its supermarkets.
reference: Sainsbury's 早在本世纪之初试水与 Boots 建立了合资企业，但在入驻其超市的药店收入分成上存在纷争后，这种合作关系也就随之结束。

source: The new strategy comes after Sainsbury's sold its 281-store pharmacy business to Celesio, the owner of the Lloyds Pharmacy chain, for £125m, three years ago.
reference: 三年前，Sainsbury's 将其拥有的 281 家药店的业务以 1.25 亿英镑的价格出售给了 Lloyds Pharmacy 连锁所有人 Celesio 后，新的策略腾空出世。

source: It said Lloyds would play a role in the plan, by adding an extended range of luxury skincare brands including La Roche-Posay and Vichy in four stores.
reference: 它表示，Lloyds 将在四家店增加销售包括 La Roche-Posay 和 Vichy 在内的奢侈护肤品牌产品系列，从而在计划中发挥作用。

source: Paul Mills-Hicks, Sainsbury's commercial director, said: "We've transformed the look and feel of our beauty aisles to enhance the environment for our customers.
reference: Sainsbury's 商业总监 Paul Mills-Hicks 说:“我们的美容品销售通道已改头换面，从而提升顾客的购物环境。

source: We've also invested in specially trained colleagues who will be on hand to offer advice.
reference: 我们还投资对员工进行专门培训，使他们能随时提供建议。

source: Our range of brands is designed to suit every need and the alluring environment and convenient locations mean we're now a compelling beauty destination which challenges the old way of shopping."
reference: 我们的品牌系列旨在满足（顾客）方方面面的需求。如今，迷人的购物环境和便利的地理位置，是对老式购物方式的挑战，也使我们成为购买美容品的不二目的地。"

source: Indonesia Tsunami and Quake Devastate an Island, Killing Hundreds
reference: 印度尼西亚的海啸和地震摧毁了岛屿，造成了几百人丧生

source: In the aftermath of the Lombok earthquake, for instance, foreign nongovernmental organizations were told they were not needed.
reference: 龙目岛地震过后，例如国外的非政府组织被告知 无需其帮助（援助）。

source: Even though more than 10 percent of Lombok's population had been dislocated, no national disaster was declared, a prerequisite for catalyzing international aid.
reference: 尽管龙目岛的10%人口已经撤离，对外宣布国难是促成国际援助的前提条件，但（该国）并未这样做。

source: "In many cases, unfortunately, they've been very clear that they're not requesting international assistance, so it's a bit challenging," Ms. Sumbung said.
reference: "不幸的是，很多情况下，他们十分清楚其未请求国际援助，因此，他们会面临不少挑战，” Sumbung 女士说。

source: While Save the Children is putting together a team to travel to Palu, it is not yet sure whether foreign staff can work on the ground.
reference: 尽管“救助儿童会（ Save the Children）”正在组建一支队伍前往巴鲁，但还无法确定外国工作人员是否能够实地开展工作。

source: Mr. Sutopo, the national disaster agency spokesman, said Indonesian officials were assessing the situation in Palu to see whether international agencies would be allowed to contribute to the aid effort.
reference: 国家减灾机构发言人 Sutopo 先生表示，印度尼西亚官员正在对巴鲁的灾害情况进行评估，以确定是否允许国际机构参与救援工作。

source: Given the earth shaking that Indonesia constantly endures, the country remains woefully underprepared for nature's wrath.
reference: 鉴于印度尼西亚总是发生地震，因此这个国家对于老天爷的震怒基本束手无策。

source: While tsunami shelters have been built in Aceh, they are not a common sight on other coastlines.
reference: 尽管亚奇省搭建了海啸避难所，但在其他海岸线并不常见。

source: The apparent lack of a tsunami warning siren in Palu, even though a warning had been in effect, is likely to have contributed to the loss of life.
reference: 尽管实施了警报，但巴鲁明显缺乏海啸警报系统，因此这可能导致了人员死亡。

source: At the best of times, traveling between Indonesia's many islands is challenging.
reference: 即便在最有利的条件下，往来于印度尼西亚众多岛屿之间也不是件容易的事情。

source: Natural disasters make logistics even more complicated.
reference: 自然灾害使物流工作变得更为复杂。

source: A hospital ship that had been stationed in Lombok to treat earthquake victims is making its way to Palu, but it will take at least three days to reach the site of the new calamity.
reference: 一艘派驻龙目岛治疗地震受害者的医疗船正驶往巴鲁，但至少要三天才能到达新发灾难现场。

source: President Joko Widodo made improving Indonesia's tattered infrastructure a centerpiece of his election campaign, and he has lavished money on roads and railways.
reference: 佐科维多多（Joko Widodo）总统将改善印尼的基础设施作为其竞选活动的核心，并在公路和铁路方面进行了巨额投资。

source: But funding shortfalls have plagued Mr. Joko's administration as he faces re-election next year.
reference: 但资金短缺使佐科政府四面楚歌，明年他还要参加竞选连任。

source: Mr. Joko is also facing pressure from lingering sectarian tensions in Indonesia, where members of the Muslim majority have embraced a more conservative form of the faith.
reference: 佐科先生还面临着印尼教派之间挥之不去的紧张关系所带来的压力，在印尼，穆斯林是占大多数的教派，其成员信奉更为保守的信仰。

source: More than 1,000 people were killed and tens of thousands dislocated from their homes as Christian and Muslim gangs battled on the streets, using machetes, bows and arrows, and other crude weapons.
reference: 基督教和穆斯林帮派使用大刀、弓箭和其他原始武器在街上干仗，超过1000人丧命，上万人流离失所。

source: Death toll from Indonesia tsunami rises to 832
reference: 印尼海啸死亡人数已上升到 832 人

source: The death toll in Indonesia's earthquake and tsunami has climbed to 832, the country's disaster agency said early Sunday.
reference: 印尼国家减灾机构周日一早表示，印尼地震和海啸造成的死亡人数已攀升至 832 人。

source: Many people were reported trapped in the rubble of buildings brought down in the 7.5 magnitude earthquake which struck Friday and triggered waves as high as 20 feet, agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho told a news conference.
reference: 该机构发言人发言人Sutopo Purwo Nugroho 在新闻发布会上说，据报道，很多人受困于周五发生的7.5级地震震垮的建筑废墟中， 此次地震触发的海浪高达 20 英尺。

source: The city of Palu, which has more than 380,000 people, was strewn with debris from collapsed buildings.
reference: 巴鲁市人口超过 38 万, 震后，到处是坍塌建筑物的废墟。

source: Killer Pig Mauls Chinese Farmer to Death
reference: 杀人猪咬死中国农民

source: A farmer was attacked and killed by a pig in a market in southwest China, according to local media reports.
reference: 据地方媒体报道，中国西南部的一个农民被猪袭击致死。

source: The man, identified only by his surname "Yuan," was found dead with a severed artery, covered in blood near a sty at the market in Liupanshui in Guizhou province, the South China Morning Post reported Sunday.
reference: 南华早报周日报道，在贵州省六盘水一个市场的猪圈附近发现一名死在血泊中的“袁（音译）”姓男子，其动脉被切断。

source: A pig farmer prepares to inject vaccines into pigs at a hoggery on May 30, 2005 in Xining of Qinghai Province, China.
reference: 2005 年 5 月30日，中国青海省西宁一位养猪户准备给养猪场的猪注射疫苗。

source: He had reportedly travelled with his cousin from the neighboring Yunnan province Wednesday to sell 15 pigs at the market.
reference: 据报道，他同其表兄周三从相邻的云南省过来在该市场出售 15 头猪。

source: The following morning, his cousin found him dead, and discovered a door to a neighbouring pig sty open.
reference: 第二天早晨，其表兄发现其已死亡，而且发现附近的猪圈的门是开着的。

source: He said that in the sty was a large male pig with blood on its mouth.
reference: 他说，在那个猪圈里有一头大公猪，嘴里有血。

source: A forensic examination confirmed that the 550 pound hog had mauled the farmer to death, according to the report.
reference: 据报道，法医检查确认是这头 550 磅重的公猪撕咬该农民致其死亡的。

source: "My cousin's legs were bloody and mangled," the cousin, referred to by his surname "Wu," said, as quoted by the Guiyang Evening News.
reference: 贵阳晚报引述其”吴（音译）“姓表兄的话说“我表兄的腿血肉模糊，”

source: Security camera footage showed Yuan entering the market at 4.40 am Thursday to feed his pigs.
reference: 安防摄像头的画面显示，“袁”某于周四早晨 4:40 进入市场喂猪。

source: His body was found about an hour later.
reference: 大约1个小时候发现其尸首。

source: The animal who killed the man did not belong to Yuan or his cousin.
reference: 咬死该名男子的公猪不是其或其表兄养的猪。

source: A market manager told the Evening News that the pig had been locked away to prevent it attacking anyone else, while police gathered evidence at the scene.
reference: 市场经理告诉“晚报”， 已将该头猪锁住，以防止其攻击其他人，同时警方也在现场搜集证据。

source: Yuan's family and market authorities are reportedly negotiating compensation for his death.
reference: 据报道，“袁”某家人与市场管理方正在就其死亡赔偿进行谈判。

source: Though rare, cases of pigs attacking humans have been recorded before.
reference: 尽管猪袭击人事件实属罕见，但以前也有这方面的记录。

source: In 2016, a pig attacked a woman and her husband at their farm in Massachusetts, leaving the man with critical injuries.
reference: 2016 年，麻省的一名妇女及其丈夫在其农场遭到一头猪的攻击，致使该男子严重受伤。

source: Ten years previously, a 650 pound pig pinned a Welsh farmer to his tractor until his wife scared the animal away.
reference: 十年前，一头重 650 磅的猪将一名威尔士的农民顶到其拖拉机上不能动弹，最后是其妻子将这头猪吓跑的。

source: After an Oregon farmer was eaten by his pigs in 2012, one Manitoba farmer told CBC News that pigs are not normally aggressive but the taste of blood can act as a "trigger."
reference: 2012年，俄勒冈州一农民被他养的猪吃了后，一位曼尼托巴农民告诉  CBC新闻，正常情况下，猪是没有攻击性的，但是血的味道会“激发”它的攻击性。

source: "They're just being playful.
reference: "它们只是在嬉戏。

source: They're nippers, very inquisitive ... they aren't out to hurt you.
reference: 它们就像小孩子，好奇心重......它们不会主动伤害人。

source: You just have to pay them the right amount of respect," he said.
reference: 您得对它们怀有一定的尊重，“ 他说。

source: Londonderry: Men arrested after house rammed by car
reference: 伦敦德里:小轿车撞进房屋，几名男子被捕

source: Three men, aged 33, 34 and 39, have been arrested after a car was repeatedly rammed into a house in Londonderry.
reference: 一辆小轿车反复撞进伦敦德里的一所房屋后，年龄分别为 33、34 和39 岁的三名男子被捕。

source: The incident unfolded in Ballynagard Crescent on Thursday at about 19:30 BST.
reference: 周四大约 19:30 BST，Ballynagard Crescent 透露了该事件。

source: Det Insp Bob Blemmings said damage was caused to the gates and the building itself.
reference: Det Insp Bob Blemmings 表示，该建筑的大门以及建筑本体遭到损坏。

source: A crossbow may also have been fired at the car at some point.
reference: 也可能某个时候该小轿车被十字弓射中。

source: Menga strike gives Livingston 1-0 win over Rangers
reference: 利文斯顿队凭借 Menga 的进球以 1-0 战胜了流浪者队

source: Dolly Menga's first goal for Livingston secured victory
reference: Dolly Menga 为利文斯顿队 打进的第一粒球锁定了比赛胜局

source: Promoted Livingston stunned Rangers to consign Steven Gerrard to just his second defeat in 18 games as manager of the Ibrox club.
reference: 升班马利文斯顿队让流浪者队大吃一惊，这是  Steven Gerrard 作为Ibrox 俱乐部经理以来的18场比赛中输的第二场比赛。 。

source: Dolly Menga's strike proved to be the difference as Gary Holt's side moved level with Hibernian in second.
reference: Dolly Menga 的这个进球别有深意，因为 Gary Holt 的球队追平了排名第二的希伯尼安队。

source: Gerrard's side remain without an away win in the Premiership this season and face leaders Hearts, who they trail by eight points, next Sunday.
reference: Gerrard 的球队仍然有望夺得苏格拉本赛季超级联赛的冠军，下周日将迎战劲旅，在榜单上落后 8 分的 Hearts。

source: Before then, Rangers host Rapid Vienna in the Europa League on Thursday.
reference: 在此之前，流浪者队将在周四的“欧洲联赛”中主场迎战维也纳迅速队。

source: Livingston, meanwhile, extend their unbeaten run in the division to six games, with head coach Holt still to taste defeat since replacing Kenny Miler last month.
reference: 同时，利文斯顿队在其分区中将不败纪录扩大到 6 场，主教练自上月更换掉 Kenny Miler以来还未尝到失败的滋味。

source: Livingston miss chances against blunt visitors
reference: 利文斯顿队错失了赢得直率的客队的几次机会。

source: Holt's team should have been ahead long before they scored, with their directness causing Rangers all manner of problems.
reference: Holt 的球队在进球之前早就应处于领先优势，他们 的直传球让 流浪者队完全陷入困境。

source: Scott Robinson broke through but dragged his effort across the face of goal, then Alan Lithgow could only direct his effort wide after sliding in to meet Craig Halkett's header across goal.
reference: Scott Robinson 突破，但横向带球，接着 Alan Lithgow 可以更大范围插入接应 Craig Halkett 的头球破门。

source: The hosts were content to let Rangers play in front of them, knowing they could trouble the visitors at set pieces.
reference: 主队十分满足与流浪者队 同场较量，因为他们知道可能在定位球方面会给客队制造麻烦。

source: And that was the manner in which the crucial goal came.
reference: 这就是关键性进球的套路。

source: Rangers conceded a free-kick and Livingston worked an opening, Declan Gallagher and Robinson combining to set up Menga, who took a touch and scored from the centre of the box.
reference: 流浪者队被罚一任意球，利文斯顿队的机会来了， Declan Gallagher 和 Robinson 助攻为 Menga 创造机会，Menga 从禁区中部一脚射门得分。

source: By that stage, Rangers had dominated possession but had found the home defence impenetrable and goalkeeper Liam Kelly was largely untroubled,
reference: 在此之前，流浪者队在控球上占有优势，但是主队防守固若金汤，总体上未对球门员 Liam Kelly 构成威胁，

source: That pattern continued into the second half, though Alfredo Morelos did force a save from Kelly.
reference: 尽管 Alfredo Morelos 有一次进攻迫使 Kelly 出击扑救，但这种格局一直持续到下半场。

source: Scott Pittman was denied by the feet of Rangers goalkeeper Allan McGregor and Lithgow flicked wide from another Livingston set play.
reference: 流浪者队球门 Allan McGregor 用脚瓦解了Scott Pittman的射门，Lithgow 射偏了 利文斯顿队的另一个定位球。

source: Crosses continually came into the Livingston box and were continually cleared, while two penalty claims - after Halkett's challenge on substitute Glenn Middleton, and one for handball - were waved away.
reference: 利文斯顿队禁区内险情不断，但都一次次被瓦解，同时两次点球判罚请求被拒，一次是Halkett 挑战替补上场的 Glenn Middleton, 一次是手球。

source: 'Phenomenal' from Livingston - analysis
reference: 利文斯顿队表现“非凡” - 分析

source: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont at the Tony Macaroni Arena
reference: BBC Scotland 的 Alasdair Lamont 在 Tony Macaroni 球场

source: A phenomenal performance and result for Livingston.
reference: 利文斯顿队表现非凡，比赛结果同样让人大跌眼镜。

source: To a man, they were excellent, continuing to exceed expectations on this upward trajectory.
reference: 他们所有人都很优秀，在其上升期继续超乎人们的预期。

source: Their style of play and personnel has scarcely changed since their return to the top flight, but great credit has to go to Holt for the way he has galvanised the team since his arrival.
reference: 自从他们重返顶级联赛，他们的球风与球员都很少变化，但最功不可没的是的 Holt ，自从其执掌球队以来，利用他的方式激发了球队的斗志。

source: He had so many heroes.
reference: 名师出高徒。

source: Captain Halkett was immense, marshalling a superbly-organised defence, while Menga kept Connor Goldson and Joe Worrall on their toes throughout.
reference: 队长 Halkett 实力超群，其组织起了严密的防守， 而  Menga 让 Connor Goldson 和 Joe Worrall 全场不得安宁。

source: Rangers were short of inspiration, though.
reference: 然而流浪者队缺乏灵感。

source: As good as they have been at times under Gerrard, they fell well short of those standards.
reference: 尽管 Gerrard 有时教导有方，但他们确实在那些方面有所欠缺。

source: Their final ball was lacking - only once did they cut the home side open - and it is something of a wake-up call for Rangers, who find themselves in mid-table.
reference: 他们缺乏致胜进球 - 他们只有一次撕破了主队防线，这给发现自己处于中游水平的流浪者队敲响了警钟。

source: Trump says Kavanaugh 'suffered, the meanness, the anger' of the Democratic Party
reference: 特朗普说卡瓦诺“遭受到民主党的卑鄙和愤怒”

source: "A vote for Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to reject the ruthless and outrageous tactics of the Democratic Party," Trump said at a rally in Wheeling, West Virginia.
reference: "给卡瓦诺法官投票就是投票反对民主党无情、蛮横的策略，“特朗普在西弗吉尼亚州惠灵市  的一次集会上说。

source: Trump said that Kavanaugh has "suffered the meanness, the anger" of the Democratic Party throughout his nomination process.
reference: 特朗普说卡瓦诺在其接受大法官提名的整个过程中都“因民主党卑鄙和愤怒行径而遭到（不公平的待遇）”。

source: Kavanaugh testified before Congress on Thursday, forcefully and emotionally denying an allegation from Christine Blasey Ford that he sexually assaulted her decades ago when they were teenagers.
reference: 卡瓦诺周四在国会作证，情绪激动地对克莉丝汀·布莱西·福特(Christine Blasey Ford)指控他在几十年前（当时他们还是十几岁少年）对她进行的性侵犯予以了有力的驳斥。

source: Ford also testified at the hearing about her allegation.
reference: 福特也在听证会上对其指控进行了作证。

source: The President said on Saturday that the "American people saw the brilliant and quality and courage" of Kavanaugh that day.
reference: 特朗普总统周六说“美国人民在那天看到了卡瓦诺所具有的卓越素质和勇气”。

source: "A vote to confirm Judge Kavanaugh is a vote to confirm one of the most accomplished legal minds of our time, a jurist with a sterling record of public service," he told the crowd of West Virginia supporters.
reference: “投票确认卡瓦诺出任大法官，就是投票确认我们这个时代最具成就的法律人士之一 ，暨在公共服务方面具有不凡记录的法官，“ 他告诉西佛吉尼亚州的支持者们。

source: The President obliquely referred to Kavanaugh's nomination while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
reference: 特朗普总统影射提名卡瓦诺出任大法官，同时他还谈到中期选举中共和党投票率的重要性。

source: "Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
reference: "距离我们一生中最重要的选举之一还有五周时间。

source: I'm not running, but I'm really running," he said.
reference: 我不会参选，但我确实会参选，“，他说。

source: "That's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates."
reference: “我之所以四处奔波，就是想要争取成为理想人选。”

source: Trump argued that Democrats are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
reference: 特朗普认为民主党正在“抵抗和阻扰（对卡瓦诺的提名）。”

source: The first key procedural vote on the Senate floor on Kavanaugh's nomination is expected to take place no later than Friday, a senior GOP leadership aide has told CNN.
reference: GOP 一位资深领袖助手告诉 CNN，预期参议院会在周五之前对卡瓦诺的大法官提名进行第一次重要程序性投票。

source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr go top
reference: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose:Ayr 以不败战绩荣登榜首

source: Two late tries may have skewed the final result somewhat, but there is no doubt Ayr deserved to triumph in this wonderfully-entertaining Tennent's Premiership match of the day.
reference: 最后两个进球可能对比赛结果有点影响，但毫无疑问，Ayr 在当天 赏心悦目的 Tennent's Premiership 比赛中的表现实属实至名归。

source: They now top the table, the only unbeaten side of the ten.
reference: Ayr 荣登榜首，它是十支球队中唯一不败的球队。

source: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.
reference: 归根结底，要归功于他们超群的防守，而且把握机会的能力更胜一筹，这是让主队及其教练 Peter Murchie 最值得欣慰的地方。

source: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.
reference: "走到这一步，我们在比赛中得到了检验，仍然保持不败战绩，因此我应该十分满意，”他说。

source: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."
reference: Melrose 的 Robyn Christie 说："给 Ayr 队一个赞，他们把握机会的能力比我们强。”

source: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.
reference: Grant Anderson 在十四分钟的进球，Frazier Climo 得附加分，使 Ayr 领先，但是Rory Hughes 吃了一张黄牌, 使 Melrose 的士气从得分中就可以看出，而且 Jason Baggot 的进球没有得到附加分。

source: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.
reference: 恰巧在上半时就要结束之前，Climo 踢罚球扩大了 Ayr 领先优势，他得分后有得到附加分，因此中场休息时 Ayr 以 17-5 领先。

source: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.
reference: 但是 Melrose 在下半场的开局很好，Patrick Anderson 进球，Baggot 得到附加分，从而将两队分差缩小到 5 分。

source: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.
reference: Ruaridh Knott 严重受伤使比赛暂停了很长一段时间，最后被担架抬出赛场, 两队重新开战，Stafford McDowall 进球，Climo 得到附加分，让 Ayr 再次拉开比分差距。

source: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.
reference: 接下来，Ayr 场上代理队长被罚黄牌，Melrose 在场上多一人情况下，顶着巨大压力由 Bruce Colvine 进球，但没有得附加分。

source: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.
reference: 主队卷土重来，不过 Struan Hutchinson从罚球边线无球擒抱  Climo，MacPherson 在 Ayr 围挤争球的后方达阵。

source: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
reference: Kyle Rowe 接到 Armstrong 的战术踢球，然后传给 侧卫 Gregor Henry，完成了主队的第五个进球，接着 Climo故伎重演，得到附加分。

source: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust
reference: 朝鲜对没有互信单方面解除核武器说“不”

source: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.
reference: 朝鲜外交部长于周六向联合国表示，继续制裁朝鲜将加深朝美双方的不信任，朝鲜绝不会在受制裁的情况下单方面放弃核武器。

source: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.
reference: 李勇浩在年度联合国大会上发言称，在过去的一年中朝鲜已经做出了“重大让步”，例如停止和测试和导弹测试，拆毁核试验场，承诺不扩散核武器和技术。

source: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.
reference: “但我们始终未看到来自美国的任何响应”。

source: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."
reference: “如果朝鲜无法信任美国，朝鲜的国家安全将无法得到保障，在这种情况下我们不会首先单方面解除核武器”。

source: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.
reference: 李勇浩表达了对华盛顿方面无视朝鲜方面的积极举措，阻碍无核化进程的不满，他强调朝鲜并没有像以往完全拒绝单边无核化。

source: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.
reference: 李勇浩还提到6月12日金正恩与唐纳德特朗普在新加坡首脑会议上发布的联合声明：金正恩承诺努力实现“朝鲜半岛无核化”，而特朗普承诺保证朝鲜安全。

source: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.
reference: 朝鲜方面正在寻求结束1950-53年朝鲜战争的契机，而美国却声称朝鲜必须首先放弃核武器。

source: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.
reference: 此外，华盛顿还拒绝放松针对朝鲜的国际制裁。

source: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.
reference: 李勇浩表示“美国坚持”首先放弃核武器"并提高制裁压力达到其目的，甚至反对“结束战争声明”。

source: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.
reference: “想通过制裁迫使朝鲜屈服绝无可能。

source: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."
reference: 而另一方面连续制裁将使朝美双方彼此不信任感加剧。”

source: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.
reference: 李勇浩并未提及美国领导人本周早些时候在联合国宣布的金正恩与特朗普的第二次会谈计划。

source: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."
reference: 但他强调了金正恩与韩国领导人文在寅在过去的五个月举行的三次会晤并补充道：“若只有韩国而没有美国参与解决无核化问题，朝鲜半岛无核化将陷入僵局”。

source: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.
reference: 即便如此，李勇浩在语气上也与前一年对联合国表态有很大不同。李勇浩在联合国大会上表示，“邪恶的总统先生”特朗普称呼金正恩为“火箭人”并讽刺其自寻死路，那么朝鲜导弹将不可避免地瞄准美国本土。

source: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.
reference: 去年特朗普还威胁称“完全摧毁”朝鲜，而今年特朗普却在联合国高度赞扬金正恩解除核武的举措，但与此同时特朗普表示还有许多问题需要解决，朝鲜必须首先放弃核武器才能停止制裁。

source: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."
reference: 特朗普周三表示他并没有明确的时间框架解决朝鲜问题“可能是两年、三年或五年 - 反正无所谓”。

source: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.
reference: 中国和俄罗斯提请联合国安理会对平壤方面采取的举措给予正面反馈。

source: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."
reference: 但美国国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥则向联合国表示：“安理会应继续保持制裁力度，直到我们认定朝鲜最终切实实现无核化为止。”

source: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
reference: 自2006年安理会一致通过对朝鲜制裁起以期切断平壤核计划和弹道导弹计划的资金来源。

source: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.
reference: 蓬佩奥与李勇浩在联合国进行单边会谈。联合国大会随后宣布蓬佩奥下个月将再次访问平壤以便为第二次首脑会面做准备。

source: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.
reference: 今年蓬佩奥已经对朝鲜进行了三次访问，但最后一次访问并不顺利。

source: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."
reference: 七月份蓬佩奥离开平壤时表示此次访问已经取得了进展，但仅数小时之后朝鲜便谴责其提出了“无理要求”。

source: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."
reference: 朝鲜承诺若美国采取“相应措施”，朝方将于本月与文在寅就拆除火箭基地和核武器相关事宜展开会晤。

source: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.
reference: 蓬佩奥声称，金正恩告知其此前寻求的“相应措施”意指安全保证。特朗普承诺新加坡会晤将推进朝鲜与华盛顿关系正常化。

source: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington hits out at toxic masculinity
reference: 权力的游戏演员基特·哈灵顿抨击有害的男子气概

source: Kit Harington is known for his sword-swinging role as Jon Snow in HBO's violent medieval fantasy series Game of Thrones.
reference: 基特·哈灵顿因在HBO的中世纪暴力奇幻系列《权力的游戏》中饰演剑术高超的琼恩·雪诺而被大家所熟知。

source: But the actor, 31, has hit out at the stereotype of the macho hero, saying such roles on screen mean young boys often feel like they have to be tough to be respected.
reference: 但这位31岁的男演员对典型的大男子主义英雄形象持否定态度，他表示这种银幕角色暗示年轻的男孩子常常觉得自己必须坚强才能得到他人尊重。

source: Speaking to The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said he believes 'something's gone wrong' and questioned how to tackle the problem of toxic masculinity in the #MeToo era.
reference: 提到《星期日泰晤士报》的文化版，基特认为其中的内容有失偏颇，并且提出关于如何解决“我也是”时代有害的男子气概的问题。

source: Kit, who recently married his Game of Thrones co-star Rose Leslie, also 31, admitted he feels 'quite strongly' about addressing the issue.
reference: 基特最近与《权力的游戏》中同样31岁的女搭档罗斯·莱斯利结婚，基特承认他有解决这个问题的强烈冲动。

source: 'I feel personally, quite strongly, at the moment - where have we gone wrong with masculinity?,' he said.
reference: “就我个人而言，现在我有解决这个问题的强烈冲动 - 我们所说的男子气概到底出了什么问题”他发问。

source: 'What have we been teaching men when they're growing up, in terms of the problem we see now?'
reference: “现在来看，男孩子长大之后我们所教给他们的东西存在什么样的问题呢？”

source: Kit believes television may be partly responsible for the rise in toxic masculinity thanks to its very masculine characters.
reference: 有毒的男子气概主要表现在男性化气质异常突出，而有毒的男子气概有扩大趋势基特相信电视节目可能要担负一定的责任

source: He continued: 'What's innate and what's taught?

source: Ms Davis created the cards, "to let people know there are people out there that you can go to and you can talk to, even if it's a friend.

source: Team Europe has won the 2018 Ryder Cup defeating Team USA by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.
reference: 在法国巴黎郊外的国家高尔夫俱乐部球场上，欧洲球队以16.5比10.5的比分击败美国队赢得2018年莱德杯冠军。

source: The US has now lost six consecutive times on European soil and has not won a Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.
reference: 美国已经连续六次在欧洲赛场上失利，自1993年以来还没有赢得过莱德杯冠军。

source: Europe regained the crown as the Danish captain Thomas Bjorn's team reached the 14.5 points they required to beat the United States.
reference: 当来自丹麦的托马斯·比约恩队长带领他的球队以14.5分的成绩击败美国队时，欧洲队重夺冠军。

source: US star Phil Mickelson, who struggled most of the tournament, plunked his tee-shot into the water at the par-3 16th hole, conceding his match to Francesco Molinari.
reference: 美国球星菲尔·米克尔森在锦标赛时大部分时间都表现不佳，他在第16洞第3杆的时候把发球杆扔进了水里，于是输给了弗朗西斯科·莫利纳里。

source: The Italian golfer Molinari shined in all of his rounds, becoming 1-of-4 players to ever go 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format begun in 1979.
reference: 意大利高尔夫球手莫利纳里在所有的比赛中都表现出色，自1979年开始采用目前的锦标赛模式以来，他成为四名选手中唯一以5-0-0比分获胜的选手。

source: American Jordan Spieth was blown out 5&4 by the lowest-ranked player on the European team, Thorbjorn Olesen of Denmark.
reference: 美国选手乔丹·斯皮思以5-4的比分不敌丹麦选手托比约恩·奥尔森，他是欧洲排名最低的选手。

source: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Johnson, fell 2 and 1 to Ian Poulter of England who may have played in his final Ryder Cup.
reference: 世界排名第一的球员达斯汀·约翰逊以2比1的比分输给了英格兰的伊恩·普尔特，这可能是伊恩·普尔特最后一次参加莱德杯。

source: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia became the tournaments all-time winningest European with 25.5 career point.
reference: 西班牙人塞尔吉奥·加西亚是参加过8次莱德杯的老将，他以25.5分的职业生涯积分成为欧洲赛场上的常胜将军。

source: "I don't usually cry but today I can't help it.
reference: “我一般不哭，但今天我忍不住了。

source: It's been a rough year.
reference: 这是艰难的一年。

source: So thankful for Thomas to pick me and believe in me.
reference: 非常感谢托马斯选择了我并相信我。

source: I am so happy, so happy to get the cup back.
reference: 我很高兴，很高兴能重夺冠军。

source: It's about the team., and I'm happy I was able to help," said an emotional Garcia following the European victory.
reference: 夺得冠军后，加西亚心情激动得说道：“这都是团队的功劳，我也很高兴我能帮上忙。”

source: He passes the torch to his fellow countryman John Ram who took down US golf legend Tiger Woods 2&1 in singles play on Sunday.
reference: 他将火炬传递给了同胞约翰·拉姆，拉姆在周日的单打比赛中以2 - 1击败了美国高尔夫传奇人物老虎·伍兹。

source: "The incredible pride I feel, to beat Tiger Woods, I grew up watching that guy," said 23-year-old Rahm.
reference: 23岁的拉姆说:“击败老虎伍兹让我感到无比自豪，因为我可是看着他的比赛长大的。”

source: Woods lost all four of his matches in France and now has a record of 13-21-3 career Ryder Cup record.
reference: 伍兹在法国输掉了全部四场比赛，目前他在莱德杯的战绩是13-21-3负。

source: A strange statistic by one of the greatest players of all-time, having won 14 major titles second to only Jack Nicklaus.
reference: 作为史上最伟大的球员之一，他赢得了14个主要奖项，荣誉仅次于杰克·尼克劳斯。

source: Team USA struggled all weekend to find the fairways with the exception of Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas and Tony Finau, who played high-calibre golf throughout the entire tournament.
reference: 美国队整个周末都在努力寻找平坦球道，除了帕特里克·里德、贾斯汀·托马斯和托尼·菲诺三人，因为他们在整场比赛中都表现打出了漂亮的高尔夫球。

source: US captain Jim Furyk spoke after a disappointing performance for his squad, "I'm proud of these guys, they fought.
reference: 美国队长吉姆·弗里克在球队比赛失利后说:“我为球员们曾努力战斗过而感到骄傲。

source: There was time this morning when we put some heat on Europe.
reference: 今天早上我们对欧洲队施加了一些压力。

source: We scrapped.
reference: 我们放弃了。

source: Hats off to Thomas.
reference: 向托马斯脱帽致敬。

source: He is a great captain.
reference: 他是一位伟大的队长。

source: All 12 of his players played very well.
reference: 他的12名球员都表现得很好。

source: We'll regroup, I'll work with the PGA of America and our Ryder Cup Committee and we'll move forward.
reference: 我们将重组，我将与美国职业高尔夫球协会和莱德杯委员会合作，并且我们会将继续前进。

source: I love these 12 guys and I'm proud to serve as captain.
reference: 我爱这12个人，我也很自豪能成为他们的队长。
